title.zh: 把信道的衰减率落实到一个中心化函数
title.en: Identify the channel decay on a centred state function

given.en: Assume −1/2≤λ≤1. Then φ(1)=2/3 and φ(0)=φ(2)=−1/3, so Σᵢφ(i)=0.

claim.en: K(i,j)≥0 and ΣⱼK(i,j)=1, while ΣⱼK(i,j)φ(j)=λφ(i). Also φ(1)−φ(0)=1 and φ(i)²≤4/9.

reason.zh: 第一项对应同状态转移，第二项对应两个不同状态转移；参数区间使三者都能作为概率。
reason.en: The first expression is the diagonal transition and the second is each off-diagonal transition. The parameter range makes every entry nonnegative.

reason.zh: 一行恰有一个对角元和两个非对角元，λ 的两组项在求和时抵消。
reason.en: Each row has one diagonal and two off-diagonal entries; the λ contributions cancel in the sum.

reason.zh: 把 K 写成常量矩阵加 λ 倍单位矩阵，再使用 φ(0)+φ(1)+φ(2)=0。
reason.en: Write K as a constant matrix plus λ times the identity, then use φ(0)+φ(1)+φ(2)=0.

reason.zh: 前一个数将给出根状态的精确均值差，后一个数将给出二阶矩递推中的统一误差上界。
reason.en: The first value supplies the exact conditional mean gap, and the second supplies a uniform bound in the second-moment recurrence.

title.zh: 用可观察的叶计数构造信号
title.en: Construct an observable signal from leaf counts

given.zh: 深度零观测就是根状态；下一层观测是各子树观测构成的多重集。leafSum 在叶上取 φ，并对所有子树递归求和。
given.en: At depth zero the observation is the root state; a deeper observation is a multiset of subtree observations. The statistic leafSum evaluates φ at leaves and recursively sums over subtrees.

claim.zh: leafSum(φ,n)=Sₙ=Nₙ−Tₙ/3。正则树中 Tₙ=bⁿ 是确定值，所以 Sₙ=Nₙ−bⁿ/3；Poisson 树中必须保留随机的 Tₙ。
claim.en: leafSum(φ,n)=Sₙ=Nₙ−Tₙ/3. On the regular tree Tₙ=bⁿ deterministically, so Sₙ=Nₙ−bⁿ/3. On the Poisson tree Tₙ remains random.

reason.zh: 深度零只有根这一个叶节点，所以总数为一，状态一计数由根状态决定。
reason.en: At depth zero the root is the only leaf, so the total is one and its state determines the state-1 count.

reason.zh: N、T 都对各子树相加，把减法分配进同一个子树和后，得到 leafSum 的递归式。
reason.en: Both N and T add over subtrees. Distributing the subtraction through their common sum gives precisely the leafSum recursion.

statement.zh: 正则树用 Tₙ=bⁿ；Poisson 树保留 Sₙ=Nₙ−Tₙ/3，逐个观测计算实际 Tₙ。
statement.en: Use Tₙ=bⁿ on the regular tree; on the Poisson tree retain Sₙ=Nₙ−Tₙ/3 with the actual Tₙ in each observation.

reason.zh: 随机树的总叶数会随观测改变。把它提前换成期望 dⁿ 会改变统计量，也会改变随后展开的二阶矩。
reason.en: The total leaf count varies with a random-tree observation. Replacing it by its expectation dⁿ would change both the statistic and the subsequent second-moment expansion.

title.zh: 根状态留下的均值差可以精确计算
title.en: Compute the exact separation between conditional means

given.zh: 每个孩子的状态按 K(i,·) 生成，各子树条件独立；孩子数固定为 b 或服从均值 d 的 Poisson 分布。
given.en: Child states follow K(i,·), and subtrees are conditionally independent. The child count is either b or Poisson with mean d.

claim.zh: 正则树 EᵢNₙ=bⁿ(1/3+λⁿφ(i))，因此 EᵢSₙ=(bλ)ⁿφ(i)。Poisson 树 EᵢNₙ=dⁿ(1/3+λⁿφ(i))、EᵢTₙ=dⁿ，所以 EᵢSₙ=(dλ)ⁿφ(i)。
claim.en: On the regular tree, EᵢNₙ=bⁿ(1/3+λⁿφ(i)), so EᵢSₙ=(bλ)ⁿφ(i). On the Poisson tree, EᵢNₙ=dⁿ(1/3+λⁿφ(i)) and EᵢTₙ=dⁿ, so EᵢSₙ=(dλ)ⁿφ(i).

statement.zh: 记 a=b 或 d、μₙ(i)=EᵢSₙ。条件期望给出 μₙ₊₁(i)=aΣⱼK(i,j)μₙ(j)。
statement.en: Let a=b or d and μₙ(i)=EᵢSₙ. Conditional expectation gives μₙ₊₁(i)=aΣⱼK(i,j)μₙ(j).

reason.zh: 先固定孩子状态，再对 K 的一行求平均，最后对孩子数取期望。固定分支和 Poisson 分支在这一步分别贡献 b 与 d。
reason.en: Average first over the child state using K, then over the number of children. Fixed and Poisson branching contribute b and d respectively.

reason.zh: 把归纳假设的公共因子 (aλ)ⁿ 提出，再用 Kφ=λφ，便完成一阶矩归纳。
reason.en: Factor out (aλ)ⁿ from the induction hypothesis and apply Kφ=λφ to complete the first-moment induction.

statement.en: EᵢTₙ=aⁿ and EᵢNₙ=aⁿ/3+(aλ)ⁿφ(i), whose difference gives EᵢSₙ=(aλ)ⁿφ(i).

reason.zh: 总叶数均值每代乘 a，而状态一计数的均匀部分正好是它的三分之一。中心化将这一部分完全抵消。
reason.en: The expected total leaf count multiplies by a each generation. Its third is exactly the uniform part of the state-1 count, which centring cancels.

reason.zh: 使用 φ(1)−φ(0)=1。λ 可以为负，均值差此时保留符号；转入二阶矩比较时才取平方。
reason.en: Use φ(1)−φ(0)=1. The mean gap retains its sign when λ is negative; only the second-moment comparison squares it.

title.zh: 正则分支的二阶矩受超临界参数控制
title.en: Control the regular-tree second moment using supercriticality

given.en: Put Wₙ(i)=Eᵢ[(Nₙ−bⁿ/3)²], r=bλ²>1, s=(bλ)² and Q=4r/[9(r−1)]>0.

claim.zh: Wₙ₊₁(i)=bΣⱼK(i,j)Wₙ(j)+b(b−1)[bⁿλⁿ⁺¹φ(i)]²，并且对所有 n、i 有 Wₙ(i)≤Qsⁿ。
claim.en: Wₙ₊₁(i)=bΣⱼK(i,j)Wₙ(j)+b(b−1)[bⁿλⁿ⁺¹φ(i)]², and Wₙ(i)≤Qsⁿ for every n and i.

reason.zh: 给定根状态后，各孩子子树独立同分布。平方展开中有 b 个对角项、b(b−1) 个有序非对角项。
reason.en: Conditioned on the root, child subtrees are independent and identically distributed. The square has b diagonal terms and b(b−1) ordered off-diagonal terms.

reason.zh: 先把上一层均值通过 K 再传播一次，多产生 λ；同子树的二阶矩则按 K 的一行加权。
reason.en: Propagating the previous conditional mean through K adds one factor λ; the same-subtree second moment is averaged over a row of K.

reason.zh: K 非负且行和为一控制第一项；把 [bⁿλⁿ⁺¹]² 写成 sⁿλ²，再用 φ(i)²≤4/9 控制第二项。
reason.en: Nonnegativity and the unit row sum of K bound the first term. Write [bⁿλⁿ⁺¹]²=sⁿλ² and bound φ(i)² by 4/9 in the second.

reason.zh: 代入 r=bλ²、s=br、Q=4r/[9(r−1)]。第一式覆盖初值 W₀=φ²，第二式把归纳上界收回 Qsⁿ⁺¹。
reason.en: Substitute r=bλ², s=br and Q=4r/[9(r−1)]. The first identity handles W₀=φ² and the second closes the induction at Qsⁿ⁺¹.

title.zh: Poisson 分支要同时追踪叶数的三个二阶项
title.en: For Poisson branching, track three second-order count terms

given.zh: Poisson 孩子数 B 满足 E[B]=d、E[B(B−1)]=d²。令 Vₙ(i)=EᵢSₙ²、s=(dλ)²、C=(4/9)/(1−1/(dλ²))，并假设 dλ²>1。
given.en: For a Poisson child count B, E[B]=d and E[B(B−1)]=d². Put Vₙ(i)=EᵢSₙ², s=(dλ)² and C=(4/9)/(1−1/(dλ²)), assuming dλ²>1.

reason.zh: 固定孩子数 B 展开子树和的平方：有 B 个同子树项、B(B−1) 个有序的不同子树项。对 B 取期望，两个系数分别成为 d 和 d²；交叉项用的是阶乘矩，不是 E[B²]。
reason.en: For fixed B, expand the square of the subtree sum. There are B same-subtree terms and B(B−1) ordered distinct-subtree terms. Averaging over B gives coefficients d and d²; the cross terms use the factorial moment, not E[B²].

reason.zh: Tₙ 是同一观测中的随机总叶数。按平方公式展开后，Nₙ²、NₙTₙ、Tₙ² 三个矩都要保留，随后按 1、−2/3、1/9 合并各自的递推。
reason.en: Tₙ is the random total count in the same observation. The square expansion retains Nₙ², NₙTₙ and Tₙ²; their recurrences will be combined with coefficients 1, −2/3 and 1/9.

reason.zh: u 是根状态 i 下一个孩子子树的状态一叶数均值，v 是其总叶数均值。孩子状态已通过 K 平均，所以状态信号比第 n 层多出一个 λ。
reason.en: Here u is the state-one leaf-count mean in one child subtree, conditional on root state i; v is its total leaf-count mean. Averaging the child state through K introduces one extra factor λ into the depth-n signal.

reason.zh: 把 u、v 的定义代入；两项中的 dⁿ/3 完全抵消，留下根状态的中心化信号。这里消掉的是均值里的均匀部分，并没有把随机 Tₙ 替换成期望。
reason.en: Substitute the definitions of u and v. Their dⁿ/3 terms cancel exactly, leaving the centered root-state signal. This cancels a uniform part of the means; it does not replace the random Tₙ by its expectation.

reason.zh: 不同孩子子树独立，三个矩递推中的交叉项分别为 d²u²、d²uv、d²v²。按前面的系数组合，括号内恰好配成一个完全平方。
reason.en: Distinct child subtrees are independent, giving cross terms d²u², d²uv and d²v² in the three moment recurrences. Combining them with the earlier coefficients completes the square.

reason.zh: 先代入刚得到的 u−v/3，再把 d² 与平方中的 d²ⁿ 合并。d 与 λ 的指数同为 2n+2，因而可合并为 ((dλ)²)ⁿ⁺¹，最后换成 s=(dλ)²。偶数次幂也保留了 λ<0 时的等式。
reason.en: Substitute the value of u−v/3 and combine d² with d²ⁿ from the square. Both d and λ have exponent 2n+2, giving ((dλ)²)ⁿ⁺¹. Finally use s=(dλ)². The even powers keep the equality valid when λ<0.

reason.zh: 同子树的三个矩按同样系数合并为 Vₙ，交叉项使用上一行。若 Vₙ(j)≤Csⁿ，K 非负且行和为一就把加权和控制在 Csⁿ；再用 φ(i)²≤4/9。源码先证明各矩有限，才进行这些求和。
reason.en: The same-subtree moments combine into Vₙ, and the preceding line supplies the cross term. Under Vₙ(j)≤Csⁿ, nonnegativity and unit row sums of K bound its weighted average by Csⁿ. Then use φ(i)²≤4/9. The source establishes finiteness before combining the sums.

reason.zh: s=(dλ)²=d(dλ²)=dr，所以 s−d=d(r−1)。代入 C 后，分母中的 r−1 与这个因子约去；r>1 保证约去的因子非零。
reason.en: Since s=(dλ)²=d(dλ²)=dr, we have s−d=d(r−1). Substitute C and cancel r−1 from its denominator against this factor; r>1 makes the cancellation valid.

statement.zh:
dC+(4/9)s
= dC+C(s−d) = Cs。
因此 Vₙ₊₁(i)≤Csⁿ⁺¹。

reason.zh: 将上一行的 (4/9)s 改写为 C(s−d)，dC 与 −Cd 抵消。于是递推上界中的系数恰好成为 Cs，完成从第 n 层到第 n+1 层的归纳。
reason.en: Replace (4/9)s by C(s−d) from the preceding line; dC cancels −Cd. The recurrence coefficient becomes exactly Cs, closing the induction from depth n to n+1.

statement.en:
C−4/9 = 4/[9(r−1)] > 0.
V₀(i)=φ(i)²≤4/9≤C.
Hence Vₙ(i)≤Csⁿ for every n.

reason.zh: r>1 也保证初值所需的 C≥4/9。深度零的统计量就是 φ(i)，因此 V₀=φ(i)²；把这个初值与刚完成的归纳步骤接起来，得到下一阶段可直接使用的统一二阶矩界。
reason.en: The condition r>1 also gives C≥4/9 for the base case. At depth zero the statistic is φ(i), so V₀=φ(i)². This base case and the preceding induction step give the uniform second-moment bound needed next.

title.zh: 均值差与二阶矩迫使观测分布保持距离
title.en: Mean separation and second moments keep the observation laws apart

given.zh: 取 p=P₁ⁿ、q=P₀ⁿ。正则情形使用 Nₙ 并以 bⁿ/3 为共同中心；Poisson 情形使用 Sₙ 并以零为中心。两者都有均值差平方 sⁿ>0，中心化二阶矩之和≤2Dsⁿ。
given.en: Take p=P₁ⁿ and q=P₀ⁿ. Use Nₙ with common centre bⁿ/3 for the regular tree, and Sₙ with centre zero for Poisson. In both cases the squared mean gap is sⁿ>0 and the sum of centred second moments is at most 2Dsⁿ.

claim.zh: TV(P₁ⁿ,P₀ⁿ)≥1/(4D)，对每个深度 n 都成立。这里正则树 D=Q，Poisson 树 D=C。
claim.en: TV(P₁ⁿ,P₀ⁿ)≥1/(4D) for every depth n, with D=Q on the regular tree and D=C on the Poisson tree.

reason.zh: 两个概率分布的总质量都是一，减去同一个中心 c 不改变均值差；已证的二阶矩保证所需求和有效。
reason.en: Both probability laws have total mass one, so a common centre c cancels from the mean difference. The established second moments justify the required sums.

reason.zh: 先用带权 Cauchy–Schwarz，再用 Σ|p−q|=2TV 和逐点不等式 |p−q|≤p+q。
reason.en: Apply weighted Cauchy–Schwarz, then use Σ|p−q|=2TV and the pointwise bound |p−q|≤p+q.

statement.en: Substitute the mean gap and moment bounds: sⁿ≤2TV(p,q)·2Dsⁿ=4D·TV(p,q)·sⁿ.

reason.zh: 正则树取 X=Nₙ、c=bⁿ/3、D=Q；Poisson 树取 X=Sₙ、c=0、D=C。每个根状态的二阶矩至多为 Dsⁿ。
reason.en: For regular branching use X=Nₙ, c=bⁿ/3 and D=Q; for Poisson use X=Sₙ, c=0 and D=C. Each root-conditioned second moment is at most Dsⁿ.

statement.zh: s>0、D>0，所以约去 sⁿ，再除以 4D，得到 TV(P₁ⁿ,P₀ⁿ)≥1/(4D)。
statement.en: Since s>0 and D>0, cancel sⁿ and divide by 4D to obtain TV(P₁ⁿ,P₀ⁿ)≥1/(4D).

reason.zh: 超临界条件 aλ²>1 保证 λ≠0，因此即使 λ 为负，平方尺度 s=(aλ)² 也严格为正。下界不依赖深度 n。
reason.en: Supercriticality aλ²>1 implies λ≠0, making s=(aλ)² strictly positive even when λ is negative. The resulting lower bound is independent of depth.

title.zh: 两种根状态的可区分性给出三状态优势
title.en: Two distinguishable root states give three-state posterior advantage

given.zh: 根先验在三个状态上均匀，P̄=(P₀ⁿ+P₁ⁿ+P₂ⁿ)/3。题目的 advantage 是后验分布与均匀先验之总变差的观测平均。
given.en: The root prior is uniform on three states, with P̄=(P₀ⁿ+P₁ⁿ+P₂ⁿ)/3. The stated advantage averages the total variation between the posterior and the uniform prior over observations.

claim.zh: Aₙ=(1/3)ΣᵢTV(Pᵢⁿ,P̄)，且 TV(P₁ⁿ,P₀ⁿ)≤3Aₙ。因此 Aₙ≥1/(12D)>0，对所有 n 成立。
claim.en: Aₙ=(1/3)ΣᵢTV(Pᵢⁿ,P̄), and TV(P₁ⁿ,P₀ⁿ)≤3Aₙ. Thus Aₙ≥1/(12D)>0 for every n.

statement.en: When P̄(y)>0, the posterior is πᵢ(y)=Pᵢⁿ(y)/(3P̄(y)).

reason.zh: 把均匀先验 1/3 代入 Bayes 公式；若 P̄(y)=0，三个非负的条件概率也都为零，这个观测没有贡献。
reason.en: Bayes’ formula uses the uniform prior 1/3. If P̄(y)=0, all three nonnegative conditional masses are zero and the observation contributes nothing.

reason.zh: 先把差通分，再用 P̄(y)>0 将它移出绝对值并与分母约去。
reason.en: Put the posterior difference over a common denominator, then use positivity of P̄(y) to cancel it outside the absolute value.

reason.zh: 右边每个状态的 (1/2)Σᵧ|Pᵢⁿ(y)−P̄(y)| 正是 TV；三个状态的有限和可以与观测求和交换。
reason.en: For each state the half-sum of absolute differences is exactly TV. The finite sum over three states can be exchanged with the observation sum.

reason.zh: 三角不等式经由共同的混合分布 P̄ 连接两种根状态；补上第三项只会增加非负和，最后除以三。
reason.en: Use the TV triangle inequality through the common mixture P̄. Adding the third nonnegative distance only enlarges the sum; then divide by three.

title.zh: 信息逐层衰减，但极限被挡在零上方
title.en: Information decreases with depth but its limit stays above zero

given.zh: observedLaw 满足广播递归，叶节点嵌入与多重集组装都是单射，Aₙ≥1/(12D)>0。
given.en: The laws observedLaw satisfy the broadcast recursion, leaf embedding and multiset assembly are injective, and Aₙ≥1/(12D)>0.

claim.zh: Aₙ 单调不增且收敛到 L=infₙAₙ≥1/(12D)>0，因此正则树与 Poisson 树均满足 Reconstructs。
claim.en: Aₙ is nonincreasing and converges to L=infₙAₙ≥1/(12D)>0. Both regular and Poisson trees therefore satisfy Reconstructs.

statement.zh: 存在与根状态 i 无关的随机变换 Tₙ，使 Pᵢⁿ⁺¹=PᵢⁿTₙ，且 P̄ⁿ⁺¹=P̄ⁿTₙ。
statement.en: There is a root-independent random transformation Tₙ with Pᵢⁿ⁺¹=PᵢⁿTₙ and P̄ⁿ⁺¹=P̄ⁿTₙ.

reason.zh: 从已有观测的叶状态继续广播一层，按同一孩子数分布和同一信道生成下一层；这一步不需要知道原根状态。
reason.en: Broadcast each observed leaf one more generation using the same offspring law and channel. This transformation does not need to know the original root state.

statement.zh: TV(PᵢⁿTₙ,P̄ⁿTₙ)≤TV(Pᵢⁿ,P̄ⁿ)，对三个 i 平均得 Aₙ₊₁≤Aₙ。
statement.en: TV(PᵢⁿTₙ,P̄ⁿTₙ)≤TV(Pᵢⁿ,P̄ⁿ); averaging over i gives Aₙ₊₁≤Aₙ.

reason.zh: 对两种输入施加同一随机变换不会增加总变差；再使用刚得到的平均 TV 表达式。
reason.en: Applying the same random transformation to both inputs cannot increase TV. Use the preceding average-TV formula to transfer this contraction to Aₙ.

statement.zh: 令 ε=1/(12D)>0。所有 n 都有 ε≤Aₙ，因此 L=infₙAₙ≥ε。
statement.en: Set ε=1/(12D)>0. Since ε≤Aₙ for every n, L=infₙAₙ≥ε.

reason.zh: 统一正下界把所有层的优势同时挡在零上方，因此它们的下确界也不可能为零。
reason.en: The same positive lower bound holds at every depth, so the infimum cannot be zero.

statement.zh: Aₙ 单调不增且有下界，故 Aₙ→L；由 L≥ε>0，得到 Reconstructs。
statement.en: The nonincreasing bounded-below sequence Aₙ converges to L. Since L≥ε>0, Reconstructs follows.

reason.zh: 这一步同时提供收敛和极限严格为正，正好对应题目定义中的存在 L>0 且 Aₙ→L。
reason.en: This supplies both convergence and strict positivity of the limit, exactly matching the definition requiring some L>0 with Aₙ→L.
